agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Five Pokémon fainted, but each loss was strategically productive: Lildozer and Croakatoa chipped priority targets, Bushtank enabled a free Ohmnomnom finish, Ohmnomnom dealt 22 to Sunflora, and Bugatti protected Birdlaw's entry.

Static move safety still does not price Leech Seed drain across locked Rollout turns; the Gavi profile and cartridge replay cover this matchup, but the generic oracle should eventually expose residual volatile damage.
The clean win used 27 decisions; shortening it is lower priority than preserving its reliable forced-entry sequence.

correct_choices: The only voluntary switch was Ohmnomnom to Lildozer; Lildozer then acted for three consecutive turns.
All five later switches were authoritative forced replacements after a faint.
No Pokémon switched in and switched back out without executing a move.
Fresh Fake Out was used once and Vacuum Wave finished Ponyta.
Bugatti stayed against Dustox, and Birdlaw entered at full HP before three uninterrupted Aerial Aces won.
agent_review.next_test: Run unchanged v15 Clone 2 from the identical opening and require the same no-switch-spam invariant plus a terminal reviewed win.
